scope: Measured policy-specific campaign selection and validation, not a learner simulation or human calibration.

learning_assumptions: Author-selected dependency: practice planning a box to its goal before tracking completion of multiple boxes.
The fixed bot does not learn between units. Campaign stages describe content exposure and runtime objective checks; human learning and mastery are unverified.
The 0.25 per-decision action replacement probability is an arbitrary controlled synthetic execution model, not an estimate of human error.
Targets and content are selected on the same 20 seeds. Independent holdout seeds are reported separately without post-hoc retuning.

assessment.meaning: Runtime goal completion requires pushing both initially unplaced boxes; this is a bot objective check, not human mastery.

limitations: Difficulty is a declared bot-policy completion index with seed evidence; learning assumptions require human validation.

limitations: Difficulty is a declared bot-policy completion index with seed evidence; learning assumptions require human validation.
Mechanic exposure is content-author metadata. Twist/Pressure require actual content changes, but telemetry-based mechanic mastery is not inferred.

band_diagnostics.note: These diagnostics explain exact-comparison floating-point effects. The original framework validation is retained unchanged and is authoritative for its own contract.

heldout.warning: The campaign was chosen before these disjoint seeds were evaluated. A valid selection-seed curriculum is not guaranteed to meet all bands on held-out seeds.

observed_difficulty_ordering.interpretation: Comparisons vary the actual move limit on each fixed layout using common seeds. Difficulty is derived from observed outcomes, never from level index.

impossible_request.explanation: An intro difficulty of 0.99 ± 0.001 is unavailable in the measured single-box pool; the generator must report blocked.

diversity.caveat: Feature distances measure declared structure, symbols and measured policy behavior; they do not establish perceived novelty.

independence: Sokoban game state is deterministic. Seed variation here changes the private execution-error stream; these are distinct model trials, not independent human subjects.
limitations: The 0.25 replacement probability and authored content families were chosen for a controllable test persona, not calibrated from humans.
The noiseless competent/strong Sokoban policy solves these small layouts; graded rates arise from explicit execution noise and actual move budgets.
Common seeds correlate different candidates. Wilson intervals are within-profile descriptive sampling intervals; no pooled significance or causal human claim is made.
Selection uses 20 seeds per candidate and is selection-biased. Held-out results are preserved even if targets fail.
Mechanic labels are author definitions checked against initial box counts and winning telemetry. An assessment is only a runtime WIN check.
Different layouts, move limits and mechanic sets demonstrate measurable content variation, not perceived novelty or fun.
